heading: Authority to provide travel and transportation allowances in connection with transfer ceremonies of certain civilian employees who die overseas

tree.heading: Authority.—
tree.text: A covered official may treat a covered relative of a covered employee under the jurisdiction of that covered official in the same manner the Secretary of a military department treats, under section 481f(d) 1 of title 37, next of kin and family members of a member of the armed forces who dies while located or serving overseas.

children.text: The term “covered employee” means a civilian employee—
under the jurisdiction of a covered official; and
who dies while located or serving overseas.
the Secretary of the military department concerned; and
the head of a Defense Agency or Department of Defense Field Activity.
the primary next of kin of the covered employee;
two family members (other than primary next of kin) of the covered employee; and
one or more additional family members of the covered employee, at the discretion of the Secretary a sibling of the covered employee.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: Section 481f of title 37, referred to in subsec. (a), was repealed by Pub. L. 117–81, div. A, title VI, § 604(a), Dec. 27, 2021, 135 Stat. 1767.
